title: Date - integer is a date: subtracting 1 goes back a day

source.quote: if a subtraction operation uses a date with any other data type, DAX converts both values to dates, and the return value is also a date
source.supports: the Subtraction (-) table: Date/time minus anything is Date/time

derivation: Date/time - INTEGER is Date/time. 2024 is a leap year, so the day before 2024-03-01 is 2024-02-29.
